name: Kolumna Zygmunta | Sigismund's Column
description:
# Kolumna Zygmunta
Pomnik króla Zygmunta III Wazy został wzniesiony w latach 40. XVII wieku. Koncepcję kolumny opracowali Augustyn Locci i Constantino Tencella. W latach 1885-1887 oraz 1929-1931 pomnik był restaurowany. W 1944 został zniszczony przez Niemców podczas powstania warszawskiego, a kilka lat później zrekonstruowany. W 1965 pomnik został wpisany do rejestru zabytków.
# Sigismund's Column
The monument to King Sigismund III Vasa was erected in the 1640s. The concept of the column was developed by Augustyn Locci and Constantino Tencella. The monument was restored in 1885–1887 and again in 1929–1931. In 1944 it was destroyed by the Germans during the Warsaw Uprising, and a few years later it was reconstructed. In 1965, the monument was entered into the register of historic monuments.

name: ESDA Nürburgring Grand Prix
description:
24H LAYOUT (with Nordschleife and GP) : https://mega.nz/file/NRdQUR6C#Dxsps2rd85hdFqAkZtU1ZMJilLvRENdP_cHxoMwkMaw

The Nürburgring Grand Prix (GP) circuit is a modern, FIA Grade 1 motorsports facility located in Nürburg, Germany. Constructed in 1984 and redesigned by Hermann Tilke in 2002, the 5.148 km (3.199 miles) circuit features 16 to 17 technical turns and hosts major racing series like DTM and GT Masters.

The track was completed in 1984 and named GP-Strecke. It was built to meet the highest safety standards. However, it was considered in character a mere shadow of its older sibling. Some fans, who had to sit much farther away from the track, called it Eifelring, Ersatzring, Grünering or similar nicknames, believing it did not deserve to be called Nürburgring. Like many circuits of the time, it offered few overtaking opportunities.

name: Dinas Bran Ramparts - 2025 Excavation
description:
This model shows the final outcome of the September 2025 excavation of a narrow trench through the presumed prehistoric ramparts at Dinas Bran, Llangollen - reports and results to follow.

The project was conducted in partnership by [Heneb - The Trust For Welsh Archaeology](https://heneb.org.uk/), [Cadw](https://cadw.gov.wales/) and [Clwydian Range and Dee Valley National Landscape](https://www.clwydianrangeanddeevalleyaonb.org.uk/), with archaeologists and heritage professionals working alongside students and volunteers from the local community. A big thank you to all of our dedicated diggers for their assistance and willingness to start each day with a hike up the notoriously steep hill.

Llangollen Museum's online dig diary covering the three weeks of the excavation can be seen [here](https://www.facebook.com/story.php?story_fbid=1230225452242709&id=100057657969751).

Excavation lead by Ian Grant, trench supervised by Karl Macrow, digital modelling by Matt Thomas.

https://heneb.org.uk/

name: Grave slab, 13th century
description: Grave slab in the northeastern corner of the chancel of St Mary Magdalene Church, Cobham. Tapered medieval grave slab of limestone carved in relief with a long-stemmed cross whose head forms a cross potent - a design of squared, equal arms ending in short bars - enclosed within a recessed rectangular panel at the head. The shaft runs nearly the full length of the slab, flanked by moulded borders that give a sense of architectural framing. The careful tooling and distinct cross type suggest a 13th-century date, possibly commemorating a crusader or person of ecclesiastical rank, as the cross potent was a symbol associated with the Holy Land. A visible break near the centre and the position of the other grave slabs in the church  indicate possible repositioning.

name: Alpe Mottaccio 1
description:
Alpe Mottaccio in the municipality of Prata Camportaccio (Central Italian Alps) is a clearing surrounded by larch trees at an altitude between 1,900 and 1,950 meters a.s.l., near the ridge separating the Schiesone Valley (Chiavenna Valley) from the Bregaglia Valley. There are two huts still in good condition, one in ruins, and some ruins of which only the perimeter walls remain.
This first hut, the larger one, is located at approximately 1,925 meters a.s.l. along the path leading to Lago del Grillo. It was likely used as a stable.

The model was created through photogrammetric processing of 40 photographs taken with a DJI Lito X1 drone, 58 photographs taken with a Xiaomi Mi8 smartphone and processed with RealityScan 2.1.

name: FallingWater House
description:
La Casa de la Cascada es una obra maestra de laarquitectura orgánica de Frank Lloyd Wright, construida entre 1936 y 1939 para la familia Kaufmann sobre una cascada natural en Pensilvania. Sus puntos más importantes son su perfecta integración con el entorno a través de materiales como la piedra y el hormigón, el uso de grandes ventanas para difuminar los límites entre interior y exterior, y su innovadora estructura en voladizo que parece desafiar la gravedad para flotar sobre el agua.
La casa ejemplifica la filosofía de Wright de armonizar la construcción con la naturaleza y ahora es una casa-museo pública.

name: Anfiteatro Romano de Merida | MERIDA - SPAIN
description:
The Amphitheatre of Mérida is a Roman amphitheatre in the Roman colonia of Emerita Augusta –present-day Mérida, Spain–, capital of the Roman province of Lusitania. It was completed in the year 8 BC, and is currently in ruins. It was used for gladiatorial fights and combats between beasts or men and beasts during ancient Rome. 

The city itself, Emerita Augusta, was founded in 25 BC by Augustus, to resettle emeritus soldiers discharged from the Roman army from two veteran legions of the Cantabrian Wars (the Legio V Alaudae and Legio X Gemina). The term emeritus refers to the soldiers, all of whom had been honorably discharged from service. 

No drone, "only" with 445 photos. Canon 5D Mark III.

name: Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva (景德镇窑青白釉水月观音菩萨像)
description:
Figure of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva in Water Moon Form, Jingdezhen Ware is a 700-year-old Yuan Dynasty Buddhist sculpture. Standing 67 cm tall, it takes the Water-Moon posture: leaning on a rock with crossed legs, eyes downcast. Crafted from fine porcelain with translucent qingbai glaze (pale blue-white, jade-like sheen), its robe folds flow naturally. It’s a masterwork of Yuan Jingdezhen porcelain sculpture, blending delicate molding and smooth glazing.

景德镇窑青白釉水月观音像为 700 年元代佛教造像，通高 67 厘米，呈水月观音倚坐姿态（斜倚岩石、双腿交叠，双目低垂）。造像以细瓷为胎，施青白釉莹润如玉，衣褶流畅自然，是元代景德镇窑瓷塑珍品，尽显古瓷塑工艺精妙。

name: TILAPIA FISH IN PS1 RENDER
description:
Tilápia Fish in PS1 render
Low-Poly Asset Study: Tilápia Fish (PlayStation 1 Hardware Rendering)

Technical reconstruction of a cigarette pack using authentic PlayStation 1 rendering constraints:

・ Modeling: Polygons with vertex snapping

・ Texturing: hand-painted texture + affine warping artifacts

・ Shading: Software-style dithering + vertex lighting (no modern PBR)

・ Intentional limitations: No smoothing, subpixel precision, or mipmapping.


Created as a reference for retro game asset pipelines and 3D art preservation. Explores how technical hardware flaws (affine UV interpolation, fixed-point arithmetic) defined the PS1’s distinctive visual language.

description:
The Owl House is a celebrated example of outsider art created by Helen Martins (1897–1976), who transformed her home over several decades into a visionary installation of crushed glass, cement, and sculptural figures inspired by biblical imagery, Eastern philosophy and her imagination. After Martins’ death, the property was acquired and restored by the Camdeboo Municipality and is now formally protected as a South African National Heritage Site, curated as a house museum. GDHA spatially documented the Owl House and Camel Yard in October 2025

Catalogue name: 39 Seated hooded Shepard holding lambs

Scanning technique: Photogrammetry
Camera: Canon EOS R5

Number of photos: 292

Processing software: Reality Scan

name: Styracosaurus Skull sculpt
description:
From [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Styracosaurus): Styracosaurus ("spiked lizard") is an extinct genus of herbivorous ceratopsian dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of North America. It had four to six long parietal spikes extending from its neck frill, a smaller jugal horn on each of its cheeks, and a single horn protruding from its nose, which may have been up to 60 centimeters (2 feet) long and 15 centimeters (6 inches) wide. 

This is a (wip) sculpt based on specimen AM5372 and is part of a series of skulls to show variation within the genus.

This low poly llama was requested by @12screamingLlamas 

It’s a stylized, blocky llama made using simple geometric shapes and clean colors. The goal was to keep the form minimal while still showing the playful and slightly goofy personality llamas are known for.

Sometimes simple shapes say more than high detail. A few cubes, some careful proportions, and suddenly you have a llama with attitude.

Perfect for:

Stylized game environments

name: Green Tortoise Beetle (Cassida viridis)
description:
Scan of Green tortoise beetle (*Cassida viridis*) performed with Nikon XTH250 MicroCT at the [Microscopy Platform at Department of Biology](https://portal.research.lu.se/en/equipments/microscopy-platform-at-department-of-biology), Lund University, with support from [InfraVis](https://infravis.se/), the Swedish National Infrastructure for Data Visualization. Involved people: Filip Berendt, Ingemar Markström.

**Phenotyping the morphology of the green tortoise beetle *Cassida viridis* in order to understand evolution**

In this project, we investigate divergence, local adaptation and how the rate of microevolution is affected by environmental factors in wild populations of the green tortoise beetle. The 3D-scan enable us to measure various morphological traits. By estimating the phenotypic variation and covariation between traits, we can investigate how and why populations differ in their ability to adapt to environmental changes.

Project by [ Maja Tarka](https://portal.research.lu.se/en/persons/maja-tarka).

name: Anoa – Endemic Species of Southeast Sulawesi
description:
The anoa is a rare and endemic wild bovine species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia. Often referred to as the dwarf buffalo, it is characterized by its relatively small stature, short legs, curved horns, and dark brown coat.

This 3D model presents a scientifically accurate representation of the anoa’s physical features and serves as an educational tool to promote awareness of Indonesia’s unique wildlife. As a critically endangered species, the anoa faces serious threats from habitat degradation and poaching.

Preserving the anoa is essential for maintaining the ecological balance and protecting Indonesia’s rich biological heritage.

name: Desert Rainfrog
description:
The desert rain frog is a plump species with bulging eyes, a short snout, short limbs, spade-like feet, and webbed toes. On the underside, it has a translucent area of skin through which its internal organs can be seen. It can be between 4 and 6 centimetres (1.6 and 2.4 in) long. Its color is yellowish-brown, and sand often adheres to its skin Sand sticks to the frogs entire body, excluding the mouth and nose, and can likely be attributed to a type of sticky secretion, as removal of sand from the frog is difficult.

Unlike most other species of frogs, it develops directly from the egg into adults without passing through the tadpole stage. It has a stout body with small legs, which makes it unable to hop or leap, so it walks around on the sand. Unusually for a frog, it does not require water in its habitat to survive, but it does not have any apparent adaptation to prevent water loss.[8] Its eyes are comparatively large and bulging. The lifespan ranges between 4 and 14 years

name: Etruscal seal (left ulna)
description:
3D scan of the left ulna of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

name: Red Panda Plushy
description:
My goal for this model was to create a game ready low poly model of a 3D scan, keeping the silhouette while retaining as much of the details in the texture.
Started off as a high poly scan using the Artec Spider 3D scanner and processed in Artec Studio software and used Houdini to align, center and ground to the world origin planes. Then took it into Zbrush to clean up the scan noise and fill in spots that the scanner could not capture.
I then took it into Maya to retopologize and optimize it into its final low poly form. Used Substance Designer to bake the diffuse map from the scan mesh. Then took it to Substance Painter to bake the normal map, after that was a lot of manual cleanup for the diffuse and normals as well as adding in lost details and a roughness map to get it as close to a plush fabric material for the final look.
No AI was used.

name: Muscidae sp. 3D scan
description:
3D scan of a member of the family *Muscidae* Latreille, 1802 (Pterygota: Diptera) found dead on my windowsill in Cologne, Germany. Its body length is roughly 5.6 mm.

I used the PiScAnt - a Raspberry Pi-powered version of the original [ScAnt](https://doi.org/10.7717%2Fpeerj.11155) with a Nikon EL-Nikkor 50mm 1:2.8 lens in reverse on the Rapsberry Pi HQ Cam.

3600 images were taken and stacked to 300 views with [Zerene Stacker](https://www.zerenesystems.com/) (DMap). 3D spatial data was photogrammetrically created in [Agisoft Metashape](https://www.agisoft.com/). Orientation and vertex reduction was done in [Blender 4.0](https://blender.org/).

I have not identified the specimen any further. The observation is also documented on [iNaturalist](https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/247184015/).

name: Castle Wars Pavlov VR
description:
Pavlov VR fans, rejoice!  I was finally able to rip the castle wars level, and get it uploaded here.  Included some extra textures for holiday events, and the skybox.  Feel free to use this in whatever you want, credit is appreciated, but not required.

--This is the ripped 3D model, from a mod I made for Pavlov VR years back; lost it for a few years, after my hard drive died.   It started as a recreation of the Halo cutsom mode, but eventually took on a life of its own. The level focused on pure fun, and experimentation with gameplay mechanics. If you wish to keep it as close to the original version, then place item, vehicle, and weapon spawns.  I created this level because I was sick and tired of map makers locking items and skins behind pay walls, discord roles, etc.  The level is bascailly just a wild sandbox.

description:

This model was designed with a focus on storytelling, weathered materials, and the feeling of a long-forgotten vessel drifting through dangerous waters.

The ship features aged wood textures, worn sails, damaged structural details, and a dark nautical aesthetic inspired by classic pirate legends and fantasy adventures. Every section of the model was built to support immersive exploration, whether used for games, cinematics, animations, or environment showcases.

Features:

* High-detail pirate ship design
* Stylized yet cinematic atmosphere
* Game-ready topology
* Weathered wood and aged material details
* Suitable for Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, and cinematic projects

* Concept art scenes

description:
I`m proud to present to you my vision of Pepe in a vampire costume! Pepe Dracula - Pepecula!

I used Blender, 3DCoat and Photoshop to create this model.

name: Dodo (based on a reconstructed 3D scan)
description:
This is a low-poly & retopology derivation from the 3D scan, created by [Natural History Museum Vienna](https://sketchfab.com/NHMWien) under [CC Attribution-NonCommercial](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), of a reconstruction of a [Dodo (Raphus cucullatus)](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dodo-reconstruction-nhmw-zoo1-vs-95555-8027773772184625b2cff151b5f2dd15).

This variant contains the following changes:

* Geometry decimated from ~ 248k triangles to ~ 10,7k
* Retopology to ~5,3k faces [(What is Retopology?)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retopology)
* 4K textures from Diffuse and Normal
* Downsizing to a realistic size of 0.85 m


![thanks?](https://www.cenz.at/uploads/sketchfab-thanks-like.png)


**Screenshot (Blender)**

**Note:** Unfortunately, the representation on Sketchfab is not true to detail. In Blender there is no loss of quality with the normal map:

![screenshot](https://www.cenz.at/uploads/dodo-lp-rtp.png)

name: Lion
description: The lion (Panthera leo) is a large cat of the genus Panthera, native to Africa and India. It has a muscular, broad-chested body; a short, rounded head; round ears; and a dark, hairy tuft at the tip of its tail. It is sexually dimorphic; adult male lions are larger than females and have a prominent mane. It is a social species, forming groups called prides. A lion's pride consists of a few adult males, related females, and cubs. Groups of female lions usually hunt together, preying mostly on medium-sized and large ungulates. The lion is an apex and keystone predator.

description:
Церковь Святого Минаса (Սբ. Մինաս եկեղեցի) — это небольшая Армянская апостольская церковь, расположенная непосредственно в селе Татев (Сюникская область, Армения), недалеко от знаменитого Татевского монастыря. Она была построена в 1646 году по инициативе вардапета Нерсеса, который позже стал главой Сюникской епархии. Церковь представляет собой трёхнефную базилику со сводчатой крышей. Церковь расположена в центре села и окружена старинным кладбищем, на многих надгробиях которого сохранились ценные исторические эпитафии. 
Եկեղեցին կառուցվել է 1646 թվականին: Այդ մասին վկայում է շինության պատին պահպանված արձանագրությունը: 
Այն իրենից ներկայացնում է եռանավ բազիլիկ կառույց՝ կամարակապ ծածկով: Կառուցված է տեղական մոխրագույն բազալտից: Կառուցվել է Ներսես վարդապետի ջանքերով, ով հետագայում դարձել է Սյունյաց թեմի առաջնորդ:

name: Dreamcore Iridescent Candy
description:
This 3D model is part of my ongoing project exploring dreamcore aesthetics, childhood memory, and emotional temperature. Designed as an oversized candy sculpture made of liquid metal, iridescent gradients, and translucent jelly surfaces, the object reflects the tension between sweetness and hidden emotional structures.

The outer wrapper behaves like fluid chrome, shifting with pastel reflections that reference early-2000s digital textures. Inside the semi-transparent candy core floats a hand-made skeleton of tangled yarn-like strands, symbolizing unresolved memories, family narratives, and the fragile softness of early emotional experiences.

This model is intended for AR exhibition. When viewed in real space, the candy becomes a floating emotional artifact—inviting the audience to walk around it, examine its reflective surfaces, and look into its interior from impossible angles. AR allows the candy to exist simultaneously as a nostalgic object and a digital dreamcore relic.

name: Shisa_male
description:
Shisa are traditional Ryukyuan cultural artifacts and decoration, often seen in similar pairs, resembling a cross between a lion and a dog, from Okinawan mythology. People place pairs of Shisa on their rooftops or flanking the gates to their houses. Shisa are wards, believed to protect from various evils.

The origin of Shisa is traced back to ancient Egypt. The Sphinx, a symbol of protection for kings and gods in ancient Egypt, was transmitted to China as a lion through the Silk Road, and it was transmitted from China to Okinawa in the 13th to 15th centuries.

Shisa are usually placed in pairs. The one with the open mouth is male, and the one with the closed mouth is female. This represents the “A-Un” of Buddhism, which starts with a big open “A” and ends with a completely closed “Un”.

Shisa, with its charming expression and unique shape, has become a symbol of Okinawa and is also known as a symbol of tourism. In addition, Shisa figurines and keychains are popular as souvenirs from Okinawa.

name: Diana the Huntress, Louvre Museum, Paris, 2024
description:
The Diana of Versailles, also known as Diana the Huntress, is a Roman copy from the imperial period (2nd century) of a Greek bronze original from the 4th century BC. BC, generally attributed to the Athenian sculptor Leochares1. The work represents the goddess Artemis walking, her hand resting on the antlers of a small modern deer. The eponymous copy, which is also the best preserved, appears in the collections of the Louvre Museum under the number Ma 589.

Discovery2
Probably discovered in the region of Némi, in Italy, the Louvre statue was given in 1556 by Pope Paul IV to Henry II of France. It was installed in the queen's garden at the Château de Fontainebleau and enjoyed immediate popularity. In 1602, at the request of Henry IV, Barthélemy Prieur restored it3 and added a deer smaller than life size4, thus transforming the statue into Diana the Huntress.

Under the reign of Louis Finally, in 1798, the Convention decreed its return to the Louvre. In 1802, it was restored again by Bernard Lange.

name: 2023 Porsche MissionR
description:
The Porsche Mission R (2023) represents a bold step into the future of electric motorsport. With a design that blends pure racing DNA and cutting-edge sustainability, this concept car redefines what performance electric vehicles can achieve.

This 3D model highlights the sleek aerodynamic lines, lightweight composite materials, and innovative engineering that make the Mission R a symbol of Porsche’s vision for the next generation of racing. From the distinctive LED light signature to the transparent roof and rear diffuser details, every part of this model captures the spirit of precision and power.

The Mission R is powered by a dual-motor setup producing over 1,000 hp (800 kW) in qualifying mode, propelling it from 0–100 km/h in under 2.5 seconds — all while being fully electric. Inside, the driver-focused cockpit combines digital minimalism with a futuristic feel, emphasizing Porsche’s balance between performance, sustainability, and innovation.

name: 2009 BMW Sauber F1.09
description:
The BMW Sauber F1.09 was the Formula One car with which the BMW Sauber team competed in the 2009 Formula One World Championship. The car was launched on 20 January 2009 at Circuit de Valencia in Spain. It was driven by Poland's Robert Kubica and Germany's Nick Heidfeld, both retained from 2008. The chassis was designed by Willy Rampf, Walter Reidl, Christoph Zimmermann and Willem Toet with the powertrain being designed by Markus Duesmann.

As of 2025, this was the last Formula One car powered by a BMW engine and the last Sauber car utilizing with Petronas fuels, as they would supply to Mercedes the following season. The F1.09 was also the last Hinwil-based Formula One car to utilize other than Ferrari engines until the Audi R26 in the 2026 season.

name: 1975 Fittipaldi FD02
description:
The Fittipaldi FD02 was a Formula One racing car designed by Richard Divila and used by the Fittipaldi Automotive team during the 1975 Formula One season.

The FD02 was an evolution of the team's first car, the FD01, which had proven highly problematic during its debut at the 1975 Argentine Grand Prix. Designed to fix the aerodynamic and cooling issues of its predecessor, the FD02 featured significant structural changes

Like most independent cars of the era, it was constructed around an aluminum monocoque chassis and powered by the ubiquitous 3.0-liter Ford Cosworth DFV V8 engine, paired with a Hewland manual gearbox.

name: Old Coastal Fishing Boat | Game-Ready 3D Model
description:
A detailed 3D model of an old coastal fishing boat created for real-time applications. This asset was modeled in Autodesk Maya and textured using Substance 3D Painter, with a focus on achieving realistic surface wear, paint chipping, and natural aging.

The boat features additional props such as wooden oars, a lifebuoy, anchor, and fishing net to enhance visual storytelling and create a believable coastal environment. Careful attention was given to material definition, roughness variation, and edge damage to capture the look of a well-used fishing vessel.

This asset is optimized for game engines and is suitable for use in maritime, coastal, and open-world environments.

🛠️ Software Used
Autodesk Maya
Substance 3D Painter

description: The Sky Sabre is a truck-based SAM system. It replaced the former Rapier. It is the latest high mobility British air defence missile system with each unit consisting in three separate motorized components: The radar, command and control and missile vehicles. It can control the flight of 24 missiles simultaneously whilst in flight, to intercept up to 24 separate targets. The launching vehicle and radar vehicle are both installed on the 8x8 MAN SX 45 truck under licence. They are expected to operate at distances of up to 15km apart. The Sky Sabre air defence system operates the CAMM missile, entering service with the Royal Artillery in January 2022.

name: Supermarine Spitfire (Rigged & Texture Baked)
description:
**Realistic Supermarine Spitfire Blender 3d model, rigged and texture baked.**

**Watch the Product Trailer Video:  https://youtu.be/6CbtEGxNESw**

The model has been mechanically rigged, using blender's object parenting, transform locks, and object constraints. The model is not rigged with any bones.

The product comes with two versions. One version is the original model, with the non-baked materials. The second version is the model with all of the textures baked to maps.

The textures have been baked to jpg image texture maps. Most of the textures are 4K resolution maps, but some of the smaller objects use 2K and 1K Maps. Each object has its own texture maps.

**Product Contents:**

* Spitfire Blender File (Non-Bake)
* HDRI Lighting File
* 3 Leather Texture Maps
* Cockpit Texture
* 2 Logo Images
* Metal Roughness Map
* 6 Texture Painted Bump Maps
* Final Renders
* Product Images
* Spitfire Blender File (Baked Textures)
* Baked Diffuse, Normal, Metallic and Roughness Maps

description:
A realistic dark fantasy arbalest marksman character, a game-ready 3D model for RPGs, tactical fantasy games, siege scenarios and cinematic grimdark scenes. This patient humanoid sniper is shrouded in a ragged layered camouflage cloak stitched with strips of hessian, dried grass and shredded cloth, wearing a mud-smeared cloth mask with a narrow eye slit and a bracer of range-marked tally notches on one forearm. An enormous windlass-cranked arbalest is cradled across the body. The asset was generated with the help of AI and refined for clean presentation, featuring realistic hessian, shredded cloth and oiled steel textures. name: Kokushibo's Flesh Katana
description: Here is a model of Michikatsu Tsugikuni/ Kokushibo’s Nichirin Katanas from the Anime Demon Slayer, following my recent theme of Demon Slayer Swords. Michikatsu's katana is identical to the one used by his brother Yoriichi so I could reuse the model for that, I assumed that the katana seen used by Kokushibo would be the same katana that he used before becoming a demon so I have also reused that model for this variant as well. However, reference images of Kokushibo's tsuba do not have the cutouts that were present on both his human form's Katana and Yoriichi's, I have decided to keep the same model for all three katanas under my assumption that it is the same Katana. It is entirely possible that once Kokushibo infused his flesh into the blade, his flesh covered the cutouts. The blade could also do with better decals to give the impression of eyes and veins along the blades, using Adobe Illustrator isn't something i'm highly educated in and as such this sword isn't my best work but i'm still proud of it.

name: Masso con grande cavità artificiale - Tarces BZ
description:
IL REPERTO

Modello 3D di un masso unico situato sulla Collina di Tarces (Tartscher Bichl), in Val Venosta (BZ). La caratteristica principale è una grande cavità circolare isolata.

DETTAGLI TECNICI

* Diametro del foro: Circa 30 cm.

* Morfologia: I bordi netti e la geometria regolare suggeriscono un'origine artificiale e intenzionale, escludendo i classici fenomeni di erosione naturale (marmitte dei giganti).

* Riferimento visivo: Accanto al foro è stata posizionata una pigna per offrire un'immediata scala proporzionale delle dimensioni reali.

CONSIDERAZIONI ARCHEOLOGICHE

Fori di queste dimensioni su roccia fissa o grandi massi potevano avere molteplici funzioni storiche: dall'alloggiamento di pali strutturali o storici segnali di legno, fino a bacini rituali o punti di pestaggio (mortai stabili nella roccia) legati all'antico insediamento protostorico della collina.

name: Shabti Of Horemkhebi (HARGM7250)
description: A complete mummiform shabti of a man named Horemkhebi, crafted from faience and coated in a vibrant, bright blue glaze. The figure is designed with a combination of moulded relief and black painted ink details. The wig, facial features, and crossed arms are all modelled in low relief. He wears a striated tripartite wig where horizontal bands on the lappets are defined, along with a seshed-band across the forehead created by the negative space left between the painted black lines. His arms are crossed over his chest, left over right. In each hand, he holds a painted hoe, and thick bracelets are painted onto both wrists. Suspended between his shoulders on the reverse is a small rectangular seed bag decorated with a crossed-fibre pattern. The figure has suffered some structural damage; it has been cleanly broken across the lower legs and subsequently repaired, and minor surface abrasions are visible at the elbows.

name: Large Shouldered Jar (AB96)
description: A tall, shouldered wine jar dating to the mid First Dynasty (c. 2950–2900 BC). The vessel is primarily handmade, though the pronounced rolled rim and raised collar around the shoulder indicate that the neck/rim section was wheel-turned separately before being luted onto the main body. Although the base is damaged, its profile suggests it originally terminated in a narrow flat base. Fabric analysis remains inconclusive; the clay is low-porous with coarse limestone inclusions and organic chaff temper, possibly representing a mixed Nile silt and Marl clay fabric. A simple potter’s mark in the shape of an incised cross is visible on the shoulder. Excavated by the British School of Archaeology in Egypt at the site of Tarkhan during the 1911–12 season.

name: Masso "Allineamento solare con il Putia"
description:
DESCRIZIONE

Modello 3D di un masso erratico con coppelle situato in posizione panoramica verso il gruppo del Putia. Il sito si trova esattamente nel punto geografico da cui è possibile osservare il sole transitare all'interno della sella (forcella) del Sas de Putia durante il solstizio d'inverno.

CARATTERISTICHE DEL REPERTO

* Morfologia: Blocco di roccia affiorante con diverse incisioni circolari (coppelle) sulla superficie superiore.

* Fenomeno Astronomico: Al solstizio d'inverno, il sole attraversa lo spazio tra le due vette della montagna. La presenza del masso identifica questo luogo come un punto di osservazione specifico.

DATI TECNICI

* Rilievo: Fotogrammetria digitale.

description:
ATARI - VCS CX 2600 (Heavy Sixer)
(1977 - 1978)

The Atari 2600 is a home video game console developed and produced by Atari, Inc. Released in September 1977 as the Atari Video Computer System (Atari VCS), it popularized microprocessor-based hardware and games stored on swappable ROM cartridges, a format first used with the Fairchild Channel F in 1976. The VCS was bundled with two joystick controllers, a conjoined pair of paddle controllers, and a game cartridge initially Combat and later Pac-Man

description:
# About:
[The PAPOP (PolyArme POlyProjectiles, "multi-projectile multi-weapon") ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PAPOP) was a French project to construct a computerized infantry weapon for the FÉLIN system, capable of hitting hidden or protected targets. It would have combined a 35 mm grenade launcher with a 5.56×45mm NATO assault rifle, both in a bullpup configuration, complete with targeting aids and an unorthodox sight.

**PAPOP 1** - the original concept. In 1995 first prototype was proposed with 3 x 35mm grenades (Euroimpact) in an internal tubular magazine. It was deemed too heavy and the PAPOP 2 was designed as a result.

</hr>

name: "The Witcher" Castle (Ogrodzieniec Castle ruins)
description:
Most of the castles used in filming “The Witcher” series are real-life castles. Ogrodzieniec Castle near Krakow in Poland seen it in the final episode of the first season of the battle of Sudden.

Ogrodzieniec Castle rises on the highest hill of the Krakow area, on a 515 meters mountain. Build in the 14th century by the royal family and rebuilt several times throughout history. Ogrodzieniec Castle is one of the most magnificent fortresses of the Trail of the Eagles’ Nests.

After the Tatar invasion in 1241, a gothic stone castle was erected in place of the old settlement. The castle moved from one hand to another until the family of Boners, one of the wealthiest families in Poland during the Jagiellonian times, became its owners. They rebuilt the Ogrodzieniec castle into a stunning and magnificent Renaissance residence. The decline started when Swedes destroyed it in the 16th and early 17th centuries.

name: How Aricept Inhibits AChE - A Guided Tour
description:
Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) is an enzyme in the brain responsible for breaking down acetylcholine, a key neurotransmitter responsible for muscle contractions and memory systems. Under normal circumstances, inhibition of AChE would overload the body’s synapses with acetylcholine, causing them to fire continuously leading to seizures. In Alzheimer’s patients, there is observable deficiency in acetylcholine, resulting in trouble with memory and cognitive decline. In this instance, AChE’s normal function is counterproductive, so inhibiting it can reduce symptoms for Alzheimer’s patients. 

Aricept works as an inhibitor to AChE by occupying the entire active site gorge, which blocks acetylcholine from entering the enzyme. It does not permanently alter the enzyme but rather seats itself in the enzyme with noncovalent ring-to-ring interactions.

Kryger et al. (1999) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10368299/ 
PDB 1EVE: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1EVE

name: Link Shield
description:
New Drop: Classic Hylian Shield (Low-Poly)

Just finished up this stylized take on the iconic Hylian Shield. I wanted to capture that pure nostalgia but keep the mesh super clean and lightweight.

Instead of relying on heavy textures, all the details the Triforce, the Loftwing crest, the silver bracing are built directly into the geometry with flat shading. It gives it a great retro-modern vibe that catches the light perfectly.

The Details:

Style: True low-poly. No baked normal maps, just clean geometry.

Optimized: Incredibly lightweight. It won't bottleneck your performance, making it perfect for indie RPGs, mobile, or VR environments.

Game-Ready: The origin point is set exactly at the grip. You can drag and drop it straight into Unity and snap it right to your character's hand socket with zero hassle.

Hope you guys put it to good use in your projects!

name: HK MP5A3
description:
Hi, I want to show you my model of HK MP5A3 by Heckler & Koch.
In this project I paid more attention to details that are not visible at first glance, like inside mechanisms, and I also improved my texturing skills. Also tried rendering in Marmoset Toolbag for the first time, and I like the results (hope you to).
It was really tough to complete this project because I was sick, but I did it anyway.
My model has 16k verts, 18k faces, 31k tris (including the second handguard and flashlight + recoil spring with 4k verts; shows more here because of array modifier on bullets and curves) and a lot of texture sets because of ~200 px/cm texel. 
(sorry for triangulated geometry but i lost untriangulated version)
Renders of this model you can find on my Artstation

name: R8 Revolver with 5 Skins (4K)
description:
Use the Annotations to move around the scene easily and check each different Skin individually!

This model has 5 alt Skins:*Black Metal, Plain Metal, Blood Tiger Camo, Gold Plated, and Diamond Mastery (inspired by Black Ops 2).*

This model is the result of months of study and honing in my skills, which I believe have significantly improved due to this. This gun was made by following Chamferzone's Revolver Tutorial, while also throwing some of my changes into the mix - this can most easily be seen in the texturing of the alternate Skins that I've created.

This Chamferzone course was instrumental in my learning of the more advanced, professional skills in all parts of the asset creation process, and I would recommend it to anyone who already has an intermediate-level understanding of 3D and has interest in creating high-quality props.

Overall, I'm very happy with the result, and feel much more confident in my skills as an artist.

name: 上海佘山天文台
description: 佘山天文台，又名佘山观象台、中国科学院上海天文台佘山工作站、上海天文博物馆[1]，是一座始建于光绪二十五年（1899年）的一座天文台。该天文台由法国耶稣会司铎蔡尚质募款修建，并于光绪二十七年（1901年）安装了自法国订购的双筒折射望远镜和天文台的铁质圆顶。建成后，佘山天文台以星象和太阳黑子观测为主要工作，期间还曾经参与过地震等方面的科学研究。抗日战争时期，该天文台的经费受到影响并一度陷入瘫痪。中华人民共和国成立后，该天文台被中国科学院接管并重新投入科研工作，直至1987年在周边新的射电望远镜和天文观象台建造完成后正式面向游客开放。佘山天文台于2002年和2013年先后被公布为上海市文物保护单位和全国重点文物保护单位。
